description: Backend API foundation: Implement Express API routes (via Next.js API routes) for search, novel lookup, scrape initiation, and progress polling. Establishes error handling, input validation, rate limiting, and response formatting per the API contract. Does NOT yet implement job queue integration (that is FEAT-004).
steps: Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/backend/services/storage.ts with functions: (1) openDatabase() -> Database instance using better-sqlite3, (2) saveNovel(novelData) -> insert/update novels table using INSERT OR REPLACE based on url hash (SHA256 hash of URL as id), (3) saveChapter(novelId, chapterData) -> INSERT OR REPLACE into chapters table with UNIQUE(novel_id, chapter_number), (4) getNovelById(novelId) -> fetch from novels table, (5) getNovelByTitle(query, limit=10) -> search novels.title LIKE query, sort by exact match, then last_scraped_at DESC, then created_at DESC, return max 10, (6) getChaptersByNovelId(novelId) -> fetch chapters sorted by chapter_number, (7) getScrapeJobStatus(novelId) -> query scrape_jobs for most recent job with given novel_id, (8) createScrapeJob(novelId, totalChapters) -> insert into scrape_jobs, return jobId, (9) updateScrapeJob(jobId, {status, completed_chapters, last_chapter_scraped, error_message}) -> update scrape_jobs row

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/backend/services/utils.ts with: (1) hashNovelUrl(url: string) -> return SHA256 hex digest using crypto module, (2) validateSearchQuery(query: string) -> check 1-200 chars alphanumeric+space/hyphen, throw 400 error if invalid, (3) validateNovelId(novelId: string) -> check 64-char hex (SHA256), throw 400 if invalid, (4) validateFormat(format: string) -> check format in ['epub', 'pdf'], throw 400 if invalid, (5) estimateTimeRemaining(completedChapters, totalChapters, elapsedSeconds) -> simple heuristic: (totalChapters - completedChapters) * (elapsedSeconds / (completedChapters || 1)), (6) getIpAddress(req: NextApiRequest) -> extract IP from req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] or socket, return as string

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/backend/services/ratelimit.ts with simple in-memory rate limiter: (1) track requests by IP in Map<ip, {count, resetTime}>, (2) implement rateLimitMiddleware(req, res, limits) where limits = {[endpoint]: requestsPerMinute} (e.g., '/api/search': 10), (3) on limit exceeded, call res.status(429).json({success: false, error: 'Rate limited', code: 'RATE_LIMIT', retryAfter: secondsUntilReset}), (4) for MVP, store in memory (not Redis); production deployment can plug in Redis later

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/frontend/pages/api/search.ts (POST endpoint) that: (1) parse request body {query, page}, (2) validate query (alphanumeric+space/hyphen, 1-200 chars), validate page (1-100, default 1), (3) call rateLimitMiddleware for 10 req/min limit, (4) spawn Python subprocess with `python3 backend/scrapers/freewebnovel_scraper.py --search '{query}' --page {page}` (add --search and --page flags to scraper), (5) parse JSON lines from stdout (each result is one JSON object), return max 50 results, (6) on parse error, return 503 {error: 'Search temporarily unavailable'}, (7) return 200 {success: true, results: [...], totalResults, page}

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/frontend/pages/api/scrape/[novelId]/progress.ts (GET endpoint) that: (1) validate novelId (64-char hex), (2) query scrape_jobs table for most recent job with this novelId, (3) return 200 {success: true, jobId, status, completedChapters, totalChapters, percentComplete, estimatedSecondsRemaining, lastChapterTitle, error: null} based on job row, (4) if status='in_progress': set percentComplete = (completed / total * 100), estimate remaining time using utils.estimateTimeRemaining(), (5) if status='completed': set percentComplete=100, return completedAt timestamp, (6) if status='failed': include error.message from job row, (7) if no job found, return 404 {error: 'Job not found'}

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/frontend/pages/api/novel-by-title.ts (GET endpoint with query param) that: (1) validate query parameter (1-200 chars), (2) call storage.getNovelByTitle(query, limit=10), (3) return 200 {success: true, novels: [...], totalResults} with fields: novelId, title, author, url, status (e.g., 'cached' or 'in_progress'), cachedAt or progress object with {completed, total}, (4) if zero results, return {success: true, novels: [], totalResults: 0}

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/frontend/pages/api/scrape/[novelId]/chapters.ts (GET endpoint) that: (1) validate novelId, (2) query chapters table, sort by chapter_number ASC, (3) return 200 {success: true, novelId, chapters: [{chapterNumber, title, wordCount, scrapedAt}, ...], totalChapters, totalWords}

Create /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/backend/middleware/error-handler.ts with centralized error handling: catch exceptions, validate error type (InputValidationError, RateLimitError, NotFoundError), return appropriate status + JSON response, log errors to console (in dev) or external logger (production placeholder)

Create unit tests in /Users/mac/Documents/epubLegend/frontend/pages/api/__tests__/: test_search.ts (mock subprocess, verify validation, rate limit), test_progress.ts (mock db query, verify response format), test_novel_by_title.ts (mock db search, verify sort order), test_chapters.ts (mock db query, verify chapter sorting)
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/search with valid query returns 200 {success: true, results: [...]}, with invalid query returns 400 validation error
GET /api/scrape/:novelId/progress returns correct job status from database with proper percentage and time estimates
GET /api/novel-by-title?query=solo%20leveling returns sorted list (exact match first, then by last_scraped_at DESC), max 10 results
GET /api/scrape/:novelId/chapters returns chapters sorted by chapter_number with total word count
Rate limiter: exceeding 10 requests/minute to /api/search returns 429 with retryAfter header
All endpoints validate novelId format (64-char hex) and return 400 on invalid format
Running unit tests passes all assertions
verification: Run `npm run test -- frontend/pages/api/__tests__` and confirm all API tests pass
Start dev server `npm run dev`, use curl/Postman to test: POST /api/search with mock response (should fail gracefully if scraper subprocess not ready)
Test validation: POST /api/search with query='abc123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789' (>200 chars) should return 400
Verify rate limiter: make 11 requests to /api/search in <60 seconds, 11th should return 429
Verify database storage: after POST /api/search, query SQLite novels table directly and confirm novel was inserted with SHA256 hash as id
findings: Requires FEAT-001 (database schema) to be complete. Does not require FEAT-004 (queue system) yet; FEAT-004 will integrate queue into scrape endpoint. For now, /api/scrape endpoint is stubbed.
